submissions.comment: Missed the existential joke entirely, reads like a literal customer service script.
submissions.answer: I’m making this video to demand a full refund for my ticket yesterday. The event was a complete disaster. The doors opened two hours late, the audio system was completely broken, and the venue was ridiculously overcrowded. I did not get what I paid for. I expect a full refund back to my credit card immediately, or I will be forced to file a chargeback dispute with my bank.
